dedupe_keys.name: european alternative fuels observatory eafo statistics maps and ten t infrastructure data

description: The European Alternative Fuels Observatory is the European Commission's portal on alternative fuels in transport. Its home page offers infographics and visualisations of alternative fuel uptake across transport modes, EU-wide statistics comparing Member States, interactive maps and geospatial data on fleet, registration and infrastructure indicators, a TEN-T GIS map with alternative fuels infrastructure, market trends and consumer surveys, the text and guidance of the Alternative Fuels Infrastructure Regulation (AFIR) and Clean Vehicles Directive, cost calculators for total cost of ownership and charging, and a guide to contracting for recharging infrastructure. Coverage: EU Member States and transport modes. Format and access: web portal. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated on the home page. Caveats: much content is interactive, so bulk downloads must be checked per page. It supports capacity planning and transition studies of charging and refuelling networks. It relates to TEN-T maps and the US station locator in the catalogue.
